summary: Official PR12 base remains unchanged. Minimal optional first-pass interface and host person partition are implemented and compile/CPU/WARP verified. Hardware first-pass acceptance remains deferred. No file pins or inference-default changes. Mochizuki shares the host pipeline; Daniel is intentionally not implemented.
validation: MSVC host and lmxxf runtime; ABI4 C/C++ and 23 runtime cases; configuration/CRT; 144 menu layouts and catalog; WARP first/final/alpha, two-frame motion, age/reset/stale/replay/depth and closed-list lifetime; local CPU model smoke; exact official-source patch replay; existing module contract 40/80. No module recipe changes. See docs/architecture/nr-person-partition.md. No game/hardware/release certification.

decisions.reason: The opt-in implementation is complete at code/CPU/WARP level, including same-recording first-pass ownership and decode. Hardware first-pass correctness/performance and actual semantic mask quality remain acceptance work; default stays off.
decisions.evidence: docs/architecture/nr-person-partition.md; tools/lmxxf-sync/patches/first-pass-output.patch; first sink exact replay against official 48a41f files. AmdBridge and DlssNr_Menu gate unsupported Daniel without clearing the stored setting. No changes to existing HIP modules, recipes or upstream defaults. Final UI review: multi-pass capability gates the control while preserving its INI value; fixed person-status strings are translated separately from timing/error details. 144-layout/glyph test and final MSVC host build passed.

decisions.next_step: On an idle supported AMD GPU compare the first sink to independent MP1 for RGB/RGBA, actual MP2/3 and predicted MP3, history on/off, HDR and resize. Measure GPU copy/decode, CPU latency and VRAM. Validate person boundaries, occlusion and fast motion in games before enabling by default or release certification.
